book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso fɛ muh wù gɛ̀ kwe kimbe kimimia
Aju doo a kɛŋsɛ, Jiso kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ Kafanahum. Bamii yu lɛ wu le wa fɛ yeh le,
bo taashɛ fo wesee, je gɛ̀ bee gɛ yu yì taŋlo muh tomɛ kikaa mo a yeh fwɛɛŋ gɛ. Wu tu wu feeji jɛ yi Nyo bo le.
Bamii bamu gɛ̀ ja bo too banɛh bɛ muh mu fɛ wu le, bo nyu bo shumɛ yi bvuko le, wu kwe wa kimbe kimimia.
Fi ya ki bo lee bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ wu le nje bamii gɛ fasɛ baaŋ. Bo mo bo bɛɛŋ nyu a yeh we, bo chiɛɛ kiyɛ. No bo chɛle noo, bo mo bo shiishɛ muh wuyu a fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ gime yo le.
Jiso yɛŋ no bo le bo leesɛ muntele muboo ye ye le, wu mo wu jɛmɛ muh wù gɛ̀ kwe wa kimbe kimimia wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsaa yaŋ, nle nlɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ biuŋ.”

content: Bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ yɛyi banchi ba Nyo ba gɛ̀ shiiyɛ fo yu noo, bo tu bo shuŋshi a muntele le, bo biide lɛ,
“Muh wunɛ jɛme nɛ nɛɛ? Wu jode kijusɛ ki Nyo. Le yɛɛŋ wuyu wu taŋlo wu lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ fuge Nyo sɛŋ?”
Jiso mo wu kɛɛ a fitele fie le fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ kwaji, wu mo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme kfuu chi banɛ baŋkwajɛ a muntele mwɛna le nɛ njɛ la?
Fi chige fì njɛmɛ muh wunɛ le, le fì la? Ki njɛmɛ lɛ nle nlɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ bie noo, lɛ wu jo bvuko bwe wu gɛɛne la?
Geenɛ, nlé ŋgê bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme bvuŋga fɛkuu fɛnɛ ki wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ.”

content: Wu mo wu jɛmɛ muh wù gɛ̀ kwe wa kimbe kimimia wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Njɛme wo le, jâ we wo jô bvuko bwuŋ wo gɛ̂ɛne fɛ wo yeh le.”

content: Wu mo wu ja we, wu jo bvuko wu bude bamii bachii jiiŋe wu. Bo jiŋɛ nɛɛ, jwe yuŋ bo, bo tu bo tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo, bo duu lɛ, “Bee gɛ̀ baaŋ a yɛŋ gɛ kfuu chi finɛ fiɛɛ le gɛ.”
Jiso tɛɛŋ Lɛwe lɛ wu nyûme mwa ye wu ŋgoo
Jiso ka wu ja wu gɛɛŋ mbebe mamasi le, kinchvu ki bamii to fo, wu tu wu yɛyi bo.
Wu ja wu doo wu gɛɛne, wu yɛŋ Lɛwe wu le mwa Alfayu le, wu shii fɛ kijusɛ ke ki lɛme le, wu koode ŋwa. Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
Wu mo wu ja we wu bii wu le.
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛɛŋ bo jii mwɛɛ a Lɛwe yeh bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ koode ŋwa mo bamii bamu ba befe tɛ. Kfuu chi banɛ bamii tu bo bii wu le wesee.

Bafalashii ba gɛ̀ yɛyi banchi ba Nyo yɛŋ no Jiso jii mwɛɛ bɛ bamii ba befe mo ba gɛ̀ koode ŋwa, bo mo bo biih booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ, “Le nje la fì wu jii mwɛɛ bɛ bamii ba koode ŋwa mo bamii ba befe bamu?”
Jiso yu no bo biide, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bamii ba tɛɛme to bo goone muh wu nche gɛ. To goone nyu ba chɛne. Gɛ nto ki ntɛɛŋ bamii ba chaaŋ gɛ. Nto ki ntɛɛŋ nyume bamii ba befe.”

content: Kune mbaŋ mwɛɛ munjile

Lɛ to nyu, booŋ ba Joŋ ba ŋgoo mo ba Bafalashii bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile. Bamii bamu mo bo to bo biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le nje la wù booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Joŋ, mo ba Bafalashii bane mwɛɛ munjile, buŋ booŋ ba ŋgoo bane gɛ?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Taŋlo ba tɛɛŋ bamii fɛ bvuguu le bo gɛɛŋ bo tu bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile chiji bvuguu nyu bɛ bo? Gɛ taŋlo bo bane mwɛɛ munjile wù nyu bɛ bo gɛ.
Geenɛ, kife le ki to kì ba lé ba fî chiji bvuguu wuyu a bo le, bo mo bo kɛ bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile kife kiyu le.

Gɛ muh taŋlo wu jo finchaŋa fi nju fifɛŋ, wu chvuushɛ nju yì kege yu gɛ. Nɛ wu ge lo noo, finchaŋa fi nju fiyu mɛsɛ fi saayɛ lo nju yì kege yiyu, kintuge ki le fo ki mɛsɛ ki kugɛ ki fe no ki gɛ̀ shee ki nyume.

Gɛ taŋlo tɛ muh jo mbvuuŋ manfɛŋ, wu gɛɛ a kibɛɛŋ ki mbvuuŋ kì ba kɛnyɛ bɛ je yi nyaŋ, ki juŋ wa le gɛ. Wu nɛ ge lo noo, mbvuuŋ manfɛŋ mayu koo, mo saayɛ kibɛɛŋ kì kege kiyu, mbvuuŋ bɛ kibɛɛŋ mu mo mu lɛsɛ achiji. Fi kooji le lɛ, ba kɛme ki ba gɛɛde mbvuuŋ ma manfɛŋ nyume a bibɛɛŋ bì bifɛŋ le.”

content: Kune juu chi yuuŋ
Gɛ̀ bee juu chi yuuŋ chimi, Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo bo jiɛnyi bo fede mwɛ wu agiŋ wumu le. Booŋ be ba ŋgoo kɛ bo suume bichiɛɛ bo jii.
Bafalashii yɛŋ, bo biih Jiso le lɛ, “Bîjɛ wo yɛ̂ŋ, le nje la fì booŋ buŋ ba ŋgoo gee fiɛɛ fì nchi baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ lɛ muh ge juu chi yuuŋ gɛ?”
Jiso biih tɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a tɛɛŋ gɛ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le no jɛŋ gɛ̀ yu Nfoŋ Dabi bɛ ŋgoo ye wu ge gɛ?

Gɛ̀ bee kife kì Abiata gɛ̀ bee kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ, Dabi lee yeh yi Nyo le, wu jo blɛd wù ba le ba cha ba gɛɛ lɛ le wu Nyo, wu ji wu ka wu nya tɛ ŋgoo ye yu, gɛ̀ bee nchi lɛ keefɛ muh ji blɛd wuyu fede bachiji kintanyɛ gɛ.”

content: Jiso mo wu mɛsɛ wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo gɛ̀ gɛle juu chi yuuŋ nje muh. Gɛ wu gɛ fɛ muh nje juu chi yuuŋ gɛ.
Noo, muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le Chiji Kikwɛɛ ki yuuŋ.”
